scripts.postinstall: bun run scripts/duckdb-assets.ts || echo 'ccx: DuckDB assets not prepared (offline?); everything but `ccx transcript search` still works — rerun `bun run scripts/duckdb-assets.ts` when online'
scripts.install:local: bun run build && mkdir -p "${CCX_INSTALL_DIR:-$HOME/.local/bin}" && install -m 755 ccx "${CCX_INSTALL_DIR:-$HOME/.local/bin}/ccx" && echo "installed to ${CCX_INSTALL_DIR:-$HOME/.local/bin}/ccx"
scripts.install:agent: mkdir -p "${CCX_INSTALL_DIR:-$HOME/.local/bin}" && CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath -o "${CCX_INSTALL_DIR:-$HOME/.local/bin}/ccx-agent" ./apps/agent && echo "installed to ${CCX_INSTALL_DIR:-$HOME/.local/bin}/ccx-agent"
